grading: Binary pass: correct and complete answer, conditions/units/calculations, supported page/region citations; correct abstention for unanswerable; errors count as failures.
source: IPCC Climate Change 2023 Synthesis Report, physical PDF pages
tolerances: Only bt14 ±100 GtCO2 and bt15 ±50 GtCO2 permit approximate graph readings; all other expected values use stated precision.
